evals.prompt: This folder is empty. Design a landing page for my invoicing tool and give me a few directions to pick from.
evals.expected_output: up serves a scaffolded page, add --new registers four fresh positions, plan.json then 1-4 are written, one is put live, and the agent runs the await listening loop before handing off
expectations: The agent ran variate up and then variate add index.html --new --n 4
plan.json was written before the variant files
Four structurally different designs exist as .variate/index/1.html through 4.html
The agent ran variate use to put its recommendation live before presenting
After presenting, the agent ran variate await with a short --timeout at least once instead of ending its turn
The handoff names each position's direction, and explains the arrow keys and enter to keep

evals.prompt: Give me four takes on the hero section.
evals.expected_output: a round on the existing Hero component using the project's own tokens and components, presented in positions, followed by the listening loop
expectations: The agent identified the hero file by searching for visible copy, not by guessing filenames
Variant 1 is byte-identical to the original file
Every variant keeps the same exports and imports only existing dependencies
variate check was run and its warnings addressed before presenting
The agent spoke in positions (2 of 4), never filenames
The agent ran the variate await loop after the handoff

evals.prompt: I clicked keep on the card.
evals.expected_output: the queued done ask is claimed, the set is ended keeping the live file, and the reply names the kept direction
expectations: The agent drained or awaited the queue and claimed the done ask
The agent ran variate end, and the live file kept the winning variant's content
No pkill or manual process-cleanup advice was given; the agent trusted variate end to remove .variate and stop any sidecar
The ask was acked with --ack and a one line --note
The reply names the kept direction by its plan.json name, not a filename
